params.name: X-Request-ID

params.name: protocol
params.description: Exact lowercase tcp or udp matching any primary or additional listener. When listen_port is supplied, both must match the same listener. Whitespace and other spellings are rejected.

params.name: listen_port

params.name: upstream

params.name: display_id

params.name: owner_display_id

params.name: publication_state

params.name: group_id

params.name: package_product_id

params.name: cname_domain

params.name: cname_hostname

params.name: region_id

params.name: node_group_id

fields.name: package_subscription_id
fields.description: The stream's package subscription (所属套餐). A stream belongs to no website; its line, CNAME, usage and stream_ports quota are the package's unless it sets its own line / CNAME.

fields.name: listen_address
fields.description: The current runtime binds wildcard IPv4 and IPv6 listeners.

fields.name: listen_port_end
fields.description: 端口范围. When non-zero the primary listener is listen_port..listen_port_end (greater than listen_port, at most 1000 ports), each port a socket of its own that counts against the package's stream_ports. A range may not cover the node ports 80/443/18080/18443, overlap a website port or another stream's socket of the same protocol, nor be TLS passthrough; such saves are refused with stream_port_conflict whose details say where. v2 streams only. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 9 on every target node; otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: upstream_follow_port
fields.description: 跟随端口回源. Connect to the origin on the port the client connected to (for a range, the matching port). upstream_port is then stored as listen_port and may be omitted. v2 streams only. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 9.

fields.name: additional_listeners
fields.description: Extra listeners sharing this stream's endpoint, DNS and Geo policies. IDs are required client-generated UUIDs, globally distinct from every stream and other listener ID; IDs are returned in canonical order. Omitted on create means none; omitted on update preserves existing extras; an explicit empty array removes them. Any UDP listener requires both PROXY flags false. Active protocol and port pairs are reserved globally, including disabled streams, until removal or stream deletion.

fields.name: upstream_host
fields.description: Canonical lowercase IDNA host in stored responses.

fields.name: proxy_protocol_inbound
fields.description: Must be true exactly when enabled geo source resolution uses trusted_proxy_cidrs.

fields.name: proxy_protocol_v1
fields.description: Outbound Proxy Protocol v1; TCP only.

fields.name: tls_passthrough
fields.description: Forward TLS unterminated and pick this stream by SNI, so several streams, websites and at most one plain TCP stream can share the TCP port. TCP only, including every additional listener. Non-TLS connections go to the plain TCP stream on the port; TLS connections whose SNI matches nothing are closed.

fields.name: server_names
fields.description: SNI of a TLS passthrough stream, 1-32 names, empty otherwise. Exact names win over wildcards. Each (port, name) is reserved globally while the stream is live; "*.a.com" and "x.a.com" are distinct names. Stored responses are lower-case and sorted.

fields.name: max_new_connections_per_client_per_second
fields.description: 单 IP 新建连接速率. New connections (UDP sessions) one client IP may open to this stream per second, shared by all its listeners; 0 is unlimited. The client is the PROXY protocol address when the peer is a trusted proxy. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 6 on every target node; otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: new_connection_burst
fields.description: Connections allowed at once beyond the per-second rate (bucket capacity is rate + burst). Must be 0 when the rate is 0.

fields.name: new_connection_ban_seconds
fields.description: 0 refuses only connections over the rate; otherwise a client over the rate is refused new connections to this stream for this many seconds (node-local). Must be 0 when the rate is 0.

fields.name: toa
fields.description: 回源携带客户端 IP via TOA. The node writes the IPv4 client address and port into TCP option 254 (length 8) on the handshake ACK towards the origin; the origin needs a TOA module. IPv6 clients are forwarded without the option. TCP only (all listeners); excludes proxy_protocol_v1 and proxy_protocol_inbound. Requires capability L4_TOA v1 on every target node (Linux 5.10+ with the node's eBPF probe passing); otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: session_log_enabled
fields.description: 会话日志. Write a per-session access log (client IP — the PROXY protocol address when the peer is a trusted proxy — upstream, bytes, duration and end reason, refused sessions included) and register live TCP sessions for the real-time connection list. v2 streams only. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 7 on every target node; otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: guard_rules
fields.description: 防护规则. Evaluated in order on each new connection (UDP session) at the node; the first rule whose conditions all hold decides. Omitted or empty is none; responses always carry the array. v2 streams only. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 10 on every target node; a rule with a geo condition also requires IP_INTEL v2 and a verified IP intelligence library on every target node. Otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: origins
fields.description: 源站列表. Several origins on upstream_port, each with a weight (1..100, share of new connections) and down (下线, gets none); at least one up. Several origins are IP addresses; a single origin may be a domain name (then dns_policy applies). When sent, upstream_address/upstream_host are taken from the first origin; omitted keeps the single upstream_address/upstream_host. Responses always carry the list (one entry, weight 1, for a single origin). Not with upstream_follow_port when several. Several origins, or balance_way ip_hash, require TCP/UDP capability API version 11 on every target node.

fields.name: listen_ipv6
fields.description: IPv6开启. The node also listens on [::] for the stream's own sockets. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 11.

fields.name: acl
fields.description: 访问控制 IP rules. Rules are evaluated in order, the first matching rule decides; otherwise default_action (默认允许 allow / 默认拒绝 deny). The node enforces them as the stream's leading guard rules (client_ip allow / drop), ahead of guard_rules, so they need TCP/UDP capability API version 10 and count against the platform ACL rule limit together with guard_rules. Omitted on a write keeps default allow without rules.

fields.name: balance_way
fields.description: Origin connection balancing strategy; this is independent of the selected node line group.

fields.name: target_scope_id
fields.description: Required for platform principals; tenant principals may omit it or use their current scope.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.description: Required for platform principals; tenant principals may omit it or use their current user.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.description: Groups in the same scope; omitted or empty means ungrouped.

operations.summary: 批量添加 forwarding rules, one per line
operations.description: Each line is "监听端口|IP|回源端口", e.g. "88 99/udp|1.2.3.4|8080": the first port (default tcp, "/udp" or "/tcp" suffix) is the primary listener, the others additional listeners; the origin is an IP address or a domain name. template holds the fields every line shares (package, remark, timeouts, DNS policy for domain origins, …); its listen and origin fields are ignored. Lines are validated and written in order. With ignore_errors (忽略错误) a failed line is skipped and the others are committed (200). Without it the batch is atomic: one failed line and nothing is written (422, the failed line says why, the rest are skipped). The idempotency key covers the whole batch.

The node enforces them as the stream's leading guard rules (client_ip allow / drop), ahead of guard_rules, so they need TCP/UDP capability API version 10 and count against the platform ACL rule limit together with guard_rules. Omitted on a write keeps default allow without rules.

fields.name: balance_way
fields.description: Origin connection balancing strategy; this is independent of the selected node line group.

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: Purchased package snapshot name for this stream scope. List and detail reads resolve the persisted subscription; write and legacy replay responses may omit it or return null.

fields.name: package_expires_at
fields.description: Purchased subscription ends_at for this stream scope, not its usage cycle end. List and detail reads resolve the persisted subscription; write and legacy replay responses may omit it or return null.

fields.name: cname
fields.description: Current CNAME hostname. With the stream's own CNAME domain or mode (overrides) it is the stream's own hostname once written to DNS; otherwise 按套餐 (effective cname_mode package) projects the package's allocation, and 按转发 without an override has none (null).

fields.name: cname_domain
fields.description: Effective CNAME domain, the stream's own (overrides.cname_domain), then its own allocation's zone, then its package's.

fields.name: cname_hostname
fields.description: Explicit CNAME hostname; not projected for streams (null).

fields.name: cname_state
fields.type: string: pending / failed / done / null | null: pending / failed / done / null
fields.description: CNAME state (生成中 / 失败可重试 / 已生成) of the stream's own CNAME when it has an override, else of the package's allocation (按套餐 only).

fields.name: cname_failure_code
fields.description: Why the stream's own CNAME failed (cname_state failed), e.g. cname_zone_not_configured, dns_propagation_unconfirmed.

fields.name: admin_status
fields.description: 状态 (设置状态). Only normal streams are served.

fields.name: overrides
fields.description: The stream's own CNAME domain / mode and line; null follows its package. line and cname_domain are the effective values.

fields.name: line
fields.description: 线路. The region and line groups serving the stream, its own (overrides) first, else its package's.

fields.name: sync_state
fields.description: 同步状态. From the latest intent's automatic publication, whose outcome is every target node's deployment receipt (done = all healthy); pending until then. Never written by clients.

fields.name: publish_intent
fields.description: id, version, resource_revision, configuration_source_revision, and runtime_spec identify the immutable intent. publication_id, rollout_id, and state are the exact durable publication result projection; null or unknown never implies edge activation.

params.name: X-Request-ID
params.description: Caller-stable request identity; invalid or absent values are replaced by middleware.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: Reuse is accepted only for the exact same actor, operation, and normalized input.

params.name: If-Match
params.description: Quoted positive current resource revision.

fields.name: package_subscription_id
fields.description: The stream's package subscription (所属套餐). A stream belongs to no website; its line, CNAME, usage and stream_ports quota are the package's unless it sets its own line / CNAME.

fields.name: listen_address
fields.description: The current runtime binds wildcard IPv4 and IPv6 listeners.

fields.name: listen_port_end
fields.description: 端口范围. When non-zero the primary listener is listen_port..listen_port_end (greater than listen_port, at most 1000 ports), each port a socket of its own that counts against the package's stream_ports. A range may not cover the node ports 80/443/18080/18443, overlap a website port or another stream's socket of the same protocol, nor be TLS passthrough; such saves are refused with stream_port_conflict whose details say where. v2 streams only. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 9 on every target node; otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: upstream_follow_port
fields.description: 跟随端口回源. Connect to the origin on the port the client connected to (for a range, the matching port). upstream_port is then stored as listen_port and may be omitted. v2 streams only. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 9.

fields.name: additional_listeners
fields.description: Extra listeners sharing this stream's endpoint, DNS and Geo policies. IDs are required client-generated UUIDs, globally distinct from every stream and other listener ID; IDs are returned in canonical order. Omitted on create means none; omitted on update preserves existing extras; an explicit empty array removes them. Any UDP listener requires both PROXY flags false. Active protocol and port pairs are reserved globally, including disabled streams, until removal or stream deletion.

fields.name: upstream_host
fields.description: Canonical lowercase IDNA host in stored responses.

fields.name: proxy_protocol_inbound
fields.description: Must be true exactly when enabled geo source resolution uses trusted_proxy_cidrs.

fields.name: proxy_protocol_v1
fields.description: Outbound Proxy Protocol v1; TCP only.

fields.name: tls_passthrough
fields.description: Forward TLS unterminated and pick this stream by SNI, so several streams, websites and at most one plain TCP stream can share the TCP port. TCP only, including every additional listener. Non-TLS connections go to the plain TCP stream on the port; TLS connections whose SNI matches nothing are closed.

fields.name: server_names
fields.description: SNI of a TLS passthrough stream, 1-32 names, empty otherwise. Exact names win over wildcards. Each (port, name) is reserved globally while the stream is live; "*.a.com" and "x.a.com" are distinct names. Stored responses are lower-case and sorted.

fields.name: max_new_connections_per_client_per_second
fields.description: 单 IP 新建连接速率. New connections (UDP sessions) one client IP may open to this stream per second, shared by all its listeners; 0 is unlimited. The client is the PROXY protocol address when the peer is a trusted proxy. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 6 on every target node; otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: new_connection_burst
fields.description: Connections allowed at once beyond the per-second rate (bucket capacity is rate + burst). Must be 0 when the rate is 0.

fields.name: new_connection_ban_seconds
fields.description: 0 refuses only connections over the rate; otherwise a client over the rate is refused new connections to this stream for this many seconds (node-local). Must be 0 when the rate is 0.

fields.name: toa
fields.description: 回源携带客户端 IP via TOA. The node writes the IPv4 client address and port into TCP option 254 (length 8) on the handshake ACK towards the origin; the origin needs a TOA module. IPv6 clients are forwarded without the option. TCP only (all listeners); excludes proxy_protocol_v1 and proxy_protocol_inbound. Requires capability L4_TOA v1 on every target node (Linux 5.10+ with the node's eBPF probe passing); otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: session_log_enabled
fields.description: 会话日志. Write a per-session access log (client IP — the PROXY protocol address when the peer is a trusted proxy — upstream, bytes, duration and end reason, refused sessions included) and register live TCP sessions for the real-time connection list. v2 streams only. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 7 on every target node; otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: guard_rules
fields.description: 防护规则. Evaluated in order on each new connection (UDP session) at the node; the first rule whose conditions all hold decides. Omitted or empty is none; responses always carry the array. v2 streams only. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 10 on every target node; a rule with a geo condition also requires IP_INTEL v2 and a verified IP intelligence library on every target node. Otherwise publication is refused with node_capability_unavailable naming the nodes.

fields.name: origins
fields.description: 源站列表. Several origins on upstream_port, each with a weight (1..100, share of new connections) and down (下线, gets none); at least one up. Several origins are IP addresses; a single origin may be a domain name (then dns_policy applies). When sent, upstream_address/upstream_host are taken from the first origin; omitted keeps the single upstream_address/upstream_host. Responses always carry the list (one entry, weight 1, for a single origin). Not with upstream_follow_port when several. Several origins, or balance_way ip_hash, require TCP/UDP capability API version 11 on every target node.

fields.name: listen_ipv6
fields.description: IPv6开启. The node also listens on [::] for the stream's own sockets. Requires TCP/UDP capability API version 11.

Omitted on a write keeps default allow without rules.

fields.name: balance_way
fields.description: Origin connection balancing strategy; this is independent of the selected node line group.

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.description: Must exactly equal the quoted If-Match revision.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.description: Omitted keeps current membership; an empty array clears it.
